subject: Request: Short-term availability tolerance + commercial concession for ClearWave pilot
messages:
From: Asha Malhotra <asha.malhotra@clearwave-systems.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@clearwave-systems.com
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot instability — request for short-term availability tolerance and commercial relief

Hi Soojin,

Quick note from the pilot ops team: over the last 48 hours we've seen three short windows (4–12 minutes each) where request latencies spiked and a handful of inference calls failed to return. The pilot is otherwise healthy but the intermittent failures are blocking our internal QA signoff.

Given timing constraints for our board demo week of Sep 6, we want to propose two things so we can proceed without provisioning dedicated capacity immediately:
- A temporary availability tolerance (reduce uptime SLO from 99.95% to 99.5%) for a two-week window starting Aug 24.
- A goodwill commercial concession to offset the customer impact (proposal: a one-time service credit equal to 20% of August pilot spend).

Can Redwood approve a short-term SLO adjustment and commercial credit while we work through the root cause? We prefer not to take the pilot offline. I've attached a short usage extract and a draft term-sheet (see attachments).

Thanks,
Asha
Asha Malhotra
Head of Platform Partnerships, ClearWave Systems

Attachments: pilot-usage-q3.csv (csv stub), term-sheet-clearwave-draft.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Asha Malhotra <asha.malhotra@clearwave-systems.com>, procurement@clearwave-systems.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot instability — request for short-term availability tolerance and commercial relief

Team —

Looping you in for expedited review. Key facts from the customer: moderate pilot usage (attached CSV), intermittent short spikes causing failed responses but not a systemic outage. Customer asks for a 14-day temporary reduction of uptime SLO to 99.5% starting Aug 24 plus a one-time 20% credit for August spend.

Options I see:
- Approve a limited SLO tolerance window (14 days) with a conditional rollback if we identify and fix the root cause faster.
- Offer a smaller credit (10–15%) and couple with access to priority engineering support to accelerate remediation.
- Require a short-term mitigation (restrict high-burst routes) instead of a blanket SLO change.

Attachments: proposed-sla-amendment.docx (draft amendment) and the usage CSV Asha sent.

Ask: Can Marissa/Ben/Jonas sign off on a short-term SLO amendment + commercial concession? If we agree, I will send the formal amendment and update Legal/Finance for paperwork. Customer is sensitive to timeline — they need confirmation by EOD Aug 24 to avoid delaying the board demo.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: pilot-usage-q3.csv (reference)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>, Asha Malhotra <asha.malhotra@clearwave-systems.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot instability — request for short-term availability tolerance and commercial relief

Soojin/Marissa —

I support a narrow, timeboxed SLO tolerance to keep the pilot live for the board demo. My recommendation:
- Approve a 14-day SLO relaxation to 99.5% (Aug 24–Sep 6).
- Conditional commercial concession: 15% credit on billed pilot usage for August, contingent on ClearWave agreeing to priority troubleshooting and a joint post-mortem.

Rationale: 20% is steeper than we'd typically provide for a short pilot; 15% balances customer goodwill with our commercial precedent. Also ask Finance to confirm the credit mechanics (invoice credit vs. rebate). If Legal can sign the short amendment we can keep this transactional (no long-term precedent).

Marissa / Jonas — can you rubber-stamp the 15% credit + 14-day SLO tolerance? If yes I'll coordinate Finance and Legal.

- Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed-sla-amendment.docx (updated suggestion)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Asha Malhotra <asha.malhotra@clearwave-systems.com>, procurement@clearwave-systems.com
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot instability — request for short-term availability tolerance and commercial relief

All —

I approve the recommendation: 14-day temporary availability tolerance (99.5%) and a one-time 15% credit on August pilot spend, with these conditions:
1) ClearWave agrees to priority engineering time (two 2-hour troubleshooting sessions this week) and to a joint post-mortem within five business days of the tolerance window ending.
2) We use the attached short amendment and route to Legal for signoff today; Finance to process a credit invoice once the amendment is executed.
3) This approval is explicitly limited to the ClearWave pilot (deal_id DW-2027-1147) and cannot be cited as precedent for future pilots.

Soojin — please send the amendment to Asha and loop in Legal/Finance (cc Lauren for finance). Jonas — if you want to add anything, speak up now, otherwise consider this exec approval.

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Deals — Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: term-sheet-clearwave-draft.pdf (for customer visibility), proposed-sla-amendment.docx (final to Legal)
